titulo: Ligue 1: PSG survive scare to snatch a miraculous 2-2 draw at Lille
cuerpo: A dramatic start to Matchday 2 in Ligue 1. Just like last week at Rennes, Paris Saint-Germain found themselves 2-0 down, only to produce another miraculous comeback. Vitinha sparked the revival before Marquinhos rescued a point for the Parisians in Lille.
